# Getting Started {#sec-gettingstarted}

This part introduces `openMSE` and walks through the core workflow from object construction to a complete management strategy evaluation. No prior familiarity with the package is assumed.

@sec-overview introduces the primary objects and functions, explains how they fit together in the framework, and describes the S4 class system that underpins it.
 
@sec-primaryobjects gives a tour of the key object classes, with descriptions of their main slots and how they relate to each other.
  
@sec-exampleobjects provides an overview of the built-in example objects available in `openMSE`.

@sec-example-mse runs a complete MSE using a built-in operating model, covering historical simulation, specifying management procedures, and running forward projections.
